title: Plumeform layout picker and bento band
description: A near-black green band: wide bold heading and copy, then a glass list of layouts (icon, name, tier word) beside a preview card that swaps in with a quick fade-rise when you pick one, then a bento of a giant mint-gradient number, a card of three-stripe colour swatches and three short notes with mint capitals.
notes: forces dark colours; swatches take theme colour names so they re-theme
each layout's preview is a media slot (placeholder when empty)
needs JavaScript for the picker; static HTML shows the first layout
